observations.behavior: Removes the entire .stamphog directory and its README and policy.yml configuration.
observations.code_quote: - The frontmatter is a positive allow-list: only keys named in the `overrides` contract in `policy.yml` are read, within their ceilings. Anything else (unknown key, out-of-bounds value, unparseable frontmatter) invalidates the whole file - frontmatter and prose. An invalid file contributes nothing itself, but it does not cancel its ancestors: files under it still ride an ancestor's grant, or fall to the global pool if the chain grants nothing. Rationale: an author who can write an invalid file could equally delete it, so treating invalid as absent grants no extra power, and every `AGENT_APPROVALS.md` edit is human-reviewed via the `stamphog_policy` deny anyway.
